data.reasoning: The package contains only a standard PKGBUILD and .SRCINFO. The Deepseek model successfully reviewed the PKGBUILD, confirming it fetches a pinned GitHub release with a valid SHA-256 checksum and uses a standard package() function without any malicious code execution. The Qwen model's inconclusive result was due to an API error, not a security finding.
data.disagreement_analysis: The disagreement stems from a tool error in the Qwen model (HTTP 400 API failure) which prevented it from completing the PKGBUILD review, while the Deepseek model successfully analyzed the same file and found it safe.
coverage_issues: Qwen model failed to complete the PKGBUILD review due to an API error (HTTP 400 BadRequestError).
learnings: Implement retry logic or fallback mechanisms for transient API errors to prevent a single model failure from causing an inconclusive package verdict when other models can provide the assessment.
